g.text: Columns: observed rates; whiskers: nominal 95% Wilson intervals. Labels: rate and events/eligible cases. Lower ASR is better.
Models serve all LLM roles. Routes: GPT - OpenAI; Qwen - OpenRouter/Phala; Llama - OpenRouter/CoreWeave (bf16). No causal model-ranking claim.
C0T is a template control. L1 inbound; L2 documents; L3 inbound gate; L4 output; ISO channel isolation (not a layer).
